merlinlib.configuration.title: MerlinLib settings
merlinlib.configuration.hud.crosshair_da: Show the listed damage of the weapon you just used near the crosshair.
How long the crosshair damage number stays on screen, in ticks.
merlinlib.configuration.hud.collapse_ena: Fold a very large health bar into one heart plus the numbers.
merlinlib.configuration.hud.collapse_thr: Health above which the bar folds. 99 keeps a normal player bar untouched.
merlinlib.configuration.hud.armour_auto_: Move the armour row up onto the folded health row.
merlinlib.configuration.floating_text.en: Show damage numbers flying off a mob when it is hit. Off by default: a testing aid.
merlinlib.configuration.floating_text.du: How long a damage number stays visible, in ticks.
merlinlib.configuration.floating_text.ba: Base scale of a damage number.
merlinlib.configuration.floating_text.no: Colour of a normal hit, as 0xRRGGBB or a palette name.
merlinlib.configuration.floating_text.cr: Colour of a critical hit, as 0xRRGGBB or a palette name.
merlinlib.configuration.floating_text.ma: Upper bound on simultaneous damage numbers; the oldest one is dropped first.
merlinlib.configuration.particles.limit_: Cap how many particles this client draws, so a single huge hit cannot freeze it.
How many particles may be drawn per 1/20 second.
merlinlib.configuration.editor.hotkey_en: Allow the editor hotkey to open the item editor. Off by default, so the library does not claim a key.
merlinlib.configuration.editor.shift_ste: Value change when a - or + button is clicked while holding shift.
merlinlib.configuration.editor.scroll_st: Value change per mouse wheel notch over a number field.
Value change per mouse wheel notch while holding ctrl.
merlinlib.configuration.macros.enabled.t: Enable the macro toolkit: the macro screen and running macros from their bound keys.
merlinlib.configuration.security.restric: Only operators may use the toolkit
When true, only operators may use the testing toolkit.
merlinlib.configuration.security.editor_: Require command permission (operator) to open the item editor.
merlinlib.configuration.security.health_: Require command permission (operator) to open the health editor.
merlinlib.configuration.tools.enable_tes: Master switch of the testing screens. With it off no toolkit screen opens, while the testing items stay in the creative tab.
merlinlib.configuration.tools.max_test_w: Upper bound for the damage value of the test weapons.
merlinlib.configuration.tools.max_enchan: Upper bound for enchantment levels set through the item editor.
merlinlib.configuration.tools.allow_leve: Allow levels above the enchantment's maximum
Allow an enchantment above the maximum level its own definition declares.
merlinlib.configuration.tools.allow_mism: Allow any enchantment on any item
Allow any enchantment on any item, for example efficiency on a sword.
merlinlib.configuration.tools.allow_edit: Open the item editor for every item, including blocks and other things that are not weapons, tools or equipment.
merlinlib.configuration.tools.allow_non_: Edit the damage of ordinary weapons
Allow editing the base damage of an ordinary weapon too.
merlinlib.configuration.tools.health_edi: Only open the health editor while holding the health editor item.
merlinlib.configuration.content.disable_: Generate none of the enchantments defined in config/MerlinLib/*.json.
merlinlib.configuration.notices.enabled: Show the business mods' join notices
Show the join notices business mods registered through MerlinLib. The per mod switches are on the join notice page.
merlinlib.configuration.notices.open.too: Which mods may send a join notice
gui.merlinlib.notices.title: Join notice
gui.merlinlib.notices.empty: No business mod has a join notice to configure
gui.merlinlib.notices.hint: A change applies on the next join; the per mod switches live in config/MerlinLib/notices.toml
